title: Brex hero
description: A pale grey first screen as tall as the window: a 72px tightly tracked headline, a grey subtitle, an email field fused with an orange button inside a bordered card, and an orange 'watch' link. On desktop a large photo slot bleeds off the bottom right with a rounded top-left corner; on phones it sits as a full-width band under the text, with a faint peach wash at the foot.
notes: media slot: a product photo (card and phone on a pale table) that bleeds off the right and bottom edges
height follows the window (93svh minimum) on desktop and the content on phones
